quest.title: Serendipitous Encounters and a Curious Consensus
quest.description: You run into two old friends near the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge camp. A meeting between them is something you haven't considered until now...

talks.objective: Talk to the two people deep in discussion

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That's what I'm saying! We've figured it out.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Eula detests rigid, stuffy people the most! You know, the kind with 'narrow-mindedness' written all over their faces. They always get stuck obsessing over the tiniest details, and all they do is trip people up on every little step!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe they even wear a monocle and can't go anywhere without a book in their hands. But when you take a closer look, you realize they haven't really read it though, and are just using it as a prop...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: What they're really trying to do is to put on a so-called intellectual aura, and get a leg up on you before the conversation even starts!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Haha, that was spot on. I can picture it already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei and... Amber? Now that's a duo Paimon's never seen before!

choices.text: Hey! What are you two chatting about?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh hey, Honorary Knight and Paimon! You're here!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yanfei and I were just discussing if we should have a few "Big Bad Snowman" as Easter eggs in our game.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, like targets that look like monsters?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: We were thinking that, apart from the more typical monsters, we could also include some less traditional characters.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Looks like Yanfei and I share too many similar ideas about the casting!

choices.text: Yanfei, didn't expect to see you here. What a pleasant surprise!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's kind of amazing. Seeing you side by side, Paimon can tell right away you really click!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: #Yeah, I'm really surprised to run into {NICKNAME} and Paimon in Mondstadt too!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You know, this isn't actually my first time in Mondstadt. I've helped with several civil lawsuits here before...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: This time, Yaoyao and I had just finished up our work when I happened to hear about the opening of the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge, so I thought I'd check it out.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: As it turns out, after I reached the venue, I ran into Amber while asking for directions. We hit it off immediately.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: So, I decided to come try out the game Amber's managing, and chip in with some suggestions!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Heh, any friend of Eula is my friend too. And fun games are meant to be enjoyed together with other people!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Want to give this a try, Honorary Knight and Paimon? This mini-game is called "Jade Pitching," and it's designed to help our guests from far and wide to unwind and ease their stress.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Let's practice our snowball fight skills, it might come in handy in the future!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if we ever find ourselves bored with little to do, we can play to see who's better. The loser has to cook!

choices.text: In that case, I can't miss out!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Snowballs, fireballs... You know, all elemental projectiles have something in common.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: For someone as skilled in combat as you are, this should be a piece of cake!

choices.text: I'm pretty good at throwing snowballs.
I've never imagined the two of you would meet up.
